'''2001 California State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in California in 2001.<ref name="dt-15893">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15893 All For Her v1 3], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 11 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15893/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15893/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 5 May 2001<ref name="tr-d2243" />
* '''Site:''' California; A-1 Comics, Sacramento, California<ref name="tr-d2243" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]<ref name="tr-d2243" />
* '''Players:''' 63<ref name="tr-d2243" />

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Stefanko's Light Rescue The Princess deck, mains backed with high destiny and retrieval, went 3–1 at the California State Championship.<ref name="dt-15893" />

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Nick Stefanko CA State Championship 5-5-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Nick Stefanko]], 23rd, 4–4
* [[Alfred Dong The Bull at CA States (tournament report)]] — by [[Alfred Dong]], 2nd, 7–1
* [[Michael Mendoza CA Championship 5-5-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Michael Mendoza]], 17th, 5–3

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Michael Mendoza places the event at A-1 Comics in Roseville, 'not far from Sacramento'; the hub gives the site as A-1 Comics, Sacramento.<ref name="tr-d2281" />
* Mendoza thought 65 played ('Over 60 people ... 65 I think it was'); the hub gives 63.<ref name="tr-d2281" />
